reviews.name: Havyn S.
reviews.text: Great experience! Bruce was very polite and took the time to go over the detail and the status of my vehicle afterwards. He pays attention to the little things, which is super important. My car looks great.

reviews.name: Dae
reviews.text:
Booked VVM for a “Full Factory Reset.”
Bruce was exceptional! His kindness, work ethic, and attention to detail were unmatched. I will be returning. Thank you again, Bruce for your service!

reviews.name: Jenn R.
reviews.text:
Best place to get the job done. I honestly couldn’t be happier with the results. From the moment I arrived, he was incredibly welcoming, professional, and kind. He has such a calming and genuine demeanor that immediately makes you feel comfortable and taken care of.
If you’re looking for someone trustworthy, skilled, and genuinely passionate about what they do, I highly recommend VVM Car Detailing. Thank you again, Bruce — I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Tala A.
reviews.text: Bruce was amazing!! I absolutely love the results and the communication was on point! Bruce even drove all the way from Maryland to work on my car! Much appreciated!

reviews.name: Chance C.
reviews.text: As professional as they come! Asked where I would want extra care and attention to in my vehicle detail. Car came out looking pristine and you could tell little details matter to VVM

reviews.name: Jorge A.
reviews.text: They did such a great job detailing my Audi TT, from the Full Factory Reset and two step paint correction to the interior, I would definitely recommend them any day any time, they took their time with it and the results were great, thank you for driving from Maryland to Ashland. Great customer service as well, respectful and honest!

reviews.name: Samantha R.
reviews.text: The interior came out looking and smelling fresh, with the seats, cup holders, vents, and hard-to-reach areas cleaned thoroughly. Even the headliner and trim looked much better. The exterior turned out great as well the paint has a nice shine, the wheels were cleaned up, and the whole car looks almost new again. You can tell a lot of care and attention went into the work. Definitely worth it, and I’d recommend this service to anyone wanting to bring their car back to life.

reviews.name: Nicole C.
reviews.text: Bruce’s car detailing service was simply amazing!!! My car was in ROUGH shape from food / drink spills, dirt, etc. I booked the Factory Reset and he made it look brand new. He was extremely detailed, timely, and professional. At the end of the service, he explained in detail what he did and made sure to check in throughout the process. It was also a plus that he was able to travel closer to me for the service. I included some before & after pictures. 10/10 experience and am definitely going to book again! Highly recommend VVM Detailing :)
